g.text: The Retweet Cascade: A Second Fan-Out Hop
One original post can trigger TWO independent fan-out decisions, not one
The original post's own fan-out was cheap: only 300 followers, decided once, by the original author's follower count.
The retweet re-runs that SAME decision from a different starting point: the retweeter's follower count, not the original
author's. One retweet by a celebrity forces full celebrity-scale delivery for content that started completely ordinary.
